dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So, Nam, let's make a plan. What will you do first?
dialogue.reading: soʊ, ˈnɑːm, ˈlɛts ˈmeɪk ə ˈplæn. ˈwʌt wɪl juː ˈduː ˈfɜːrst?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Once I've finished my degree, I'll apply for teaching jobs.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌns aɪv ˈfɪnɪʃt maɪ dɪˈɡriː, aɪl əˈplaɪ fər ˈtiːtʃɪŋ ˈdʒɑːbz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: After I've saved enough money, I'll take the course. Maybe next summer.
dialogue.reading: ˈæftər aɪv ˈseɪvd ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni, aɪl ˈteɪk ðə ˈkɔːrs. ˈmeɪbi ˈnɛkst ˈsʌmər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I think so. I've set a goal of saving 2,000 baht a month.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk ˈsoʊ. aɪv ˈsɛt ə ˈɡoʊl əv ˈseɪvɪŋ ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt ə ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. It's smart to plan ahead, but take it step by step.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ɪts ˈsmɑːrt tə ˈplæn əˈhɛd, bʌt ˈteɪk ɪt ˈstɛp baɪ ˈstɛp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. When I've worked for a few years, I'll start working toward my own school.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. wɛn aɪv ˈwɜːrkt fər ə ˈfjuː ˈjɪrz, aɪl ˈstɑːrt ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˌwɔːrd maɪ ˈoʊn ˈskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How can you work toward that goal now?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ kən juː ˈwɜːrk təˌwɔːrd ðæt ˈɡoʊl ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I can teach children online on the weekend. Once I've done that for a few months, I'll feel more confident.
dialogue.reading: aɪ kən ˈtiːtʃ ˈtʃɪldrən ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ɑːn ðə ˈwiːkɛnd. ˈwʌns aɪv ˈdʌn ðæt fər ə ˈfjuː ˈmʌnθs, aɪl ˈfiːl ˈmɔːr ˈkɑːnfɪdənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Exactly. Let's meet again when you've had some interviews.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ˈlɛts ˈmiːt əˈɡɛn wɛn juːv ˈhæd sʌm ˈɪntərvjuːz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ms. Green. I feel much more organized now!
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈmɪz ˈɡriːn. aɪ ˈfiːl ˈmʌtʃ ˈmɔːr ˈɔːrɡənaɪzd ˈnaʊ!
